title: Sentry Agentic Capability
description: Phase 3 (Sentry_AgenticSOC_Capabilities_Brief_for_Antigravity.md, Milestone 0). A capability composes validated recipes and stable Deep Visibility templates into a multi-step, grounded workflow -- it never calls a raw MCP tool directly. That composition-only rule is enforced by capabilities/runner.py, not just documented here.

role.description: Which specialist role (brief section 3) this capability belongs to. 'framework' is reserved for Milestone 0's own trivial proof-of-mechanism capability -- not one of the six specialist roles.

trigger_intent.description: The coverage-matrix question_class (or a new capability-level intent) that invokes this capability.

plan.description: Ordered list of recipe/template references this capability composes. Never a raw tool -- the runner fails closed on any 'type': 'tool' entry (or any ref not found in the validated recipe/template libraries), per the brief's central composition rule.

type.description: 'recipe' references data/knowledge/sentinelone/recipes/<ref>.yaml by recipe_id/intent. 'template' references data/knowledge/sentinelone/dv_cookbook/<ref>.yaml by chunk_key.

ref.description: The recipe_id/intent or dv_hunt template chunk_key being composed.

name.description: Human-readable label for this step, used in output/logging.

question_template.description: A natural-language question template (Python str.format placeholders against `inputs`) fed to the existing recipe executor, e.g. 'tell me more about alert {alert_id}'. Recipes already extract entities from natural language -- this reuses that mechanism rather than inventing a second calling convention. Omit for no-input recipes.

inputs.description: Named parameters this capability accepts, resolved against the memory cache or the caller.

synthesis.description: Instructions for the Claude reasoning step over the collected, grounded recipe results. Model-agnostic per the brief's own constraint -- describes what to reason about, not a specific engine's prompt syntax. May be empty/'none' for Milestone 0's trivial framework-proof capability, which has no synthesis step yet.

separates_fact_from_interpretation.description: Must be true for every non-trivial capability -- the output must label interpretation as interpretation, never blend it with retrieved fact.

status.description: Only 'stable' capabilities run without analyst confirmation, matching the recipe schema's own status contract.

regression_fixture.description: Path to a fixture in tests/capability_fixtures/ this capability must pass.
